demande_utilisateur: Tester que ParcoursWorkflowCommand appelle indexAction une fois et retourne SUCCESS.
contexte_pertinent: Méthode 'execute' (ParcoursWorkflowCommand) — Route: (aucune) → Type de réponse: (commande Console)
test_ideal:
<?php

namespace App\Tests\Unit\Command;

use App\Command\ParcoursWorkFlowCommand;
use App\Service\ParcoursWorkflow;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use Symfony\Bundle\FrameworkBundle\Console\Application;
use Symfony\Bundle\FrameworkBundle\Test\KernelTestCase;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Command\Command;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Tester\CommandTester;

final class ParcoursWorkflowCommandTest extends KernelTestCase
{
    public function testExecuteAppelleIndexAction(): void
    {
        self::bootKernel();

        $workflowMock = $this->createMock(ParcoursWorkflow::class);
        $workflowMock->expects($this->once())
            ->method('indexAction')
            ->willReturn(Command::SUCCESS);

        $command = new ParcoursWorkFlowCommand($workflowMock);

        $application = new Application(self::$kernel);
        $application->add($command);

        $tester = new CommandTester($application->find('SUCREREG:ParcoursWF'));
        $exitCode = $tester->execute([]);

        $this->assertSame(Command::SUCCESS, $exitCode);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Début', $tester->getDisplay());
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Fin', $tester->getDisplay());
    }
}

test_ideal:
<?php

namespace App\Tests\Unit\Service;

use App\Service\OngletService;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use Symfony\Component\Form\FormView;

final class OngletServiceTest extends TestCase
{
    /** @dataProvider authorizeData */
    public function testGetAnvFormRetourneFormViewQuandAdmissionAutorisee(array $authorize): void
    {
        $mockCreanceRegroupee = $this->createMock(\App\Entity\CreanceRegroupee::class);
        $mockAnvController    = $this->createMock(\App\Controller\AnvController::class);
        $mockEntityManager    = $this->createMock(\Doctrine\ORM\EntityManagerInterface::class);

        $mockAnvController->method('getAnvFormNewOrUpdate')
            ->willReturn(new FormView());

        $service = new OngletService($mockEntityManager, $mockAnvController);
        $result  = $service->getAnvForm($mockCreanceRegroupee, false, $authorize);

        $this->assertInstanceOf(FormView::class, $result);
    }

    public static function authorizeData(): array
    {
        return [
            'admission accordée' => [['admission' => true]],
        ];
    }
}
